title: Draft of /expert-teams:create or /expert-teams:modify
description: State of the guided dialog in .claude/expert-teams/drafts/<draft>.yaml. Rewritten after every decision so a restart continues there.

kind.description: create (default): a new pipeline from /expert-teams:create. modify: a change of the existing pipeline name from /expert-teams:modify.

changes.description: modify only: the agreed changes against the current pipeline, one line each, e.g. 'add phase load-test after backend'.

name.description: Chosen pipeline name, once it is settled.

domains.description: Domain packs from <plugin>/domains/index.yaml, proposed after the brainstorming and confirmed at the start of grill me.

reasons.description: Per pack: why it fits, in one sentence.

summary.description: Running summary: goal, scope, non-goals, inputs, technology, constraints.

rules.description: Project rules settled so far, in the format of rules from pipeline.schema.json.

grillMe.description: Stage grill me: open points, contradictions and risks the orchestrator found in the brainstorming, and how they were settled.

tech.description: Software pack: the settled technology, written to docs/input/tech-stack.md at the end of grill me.

mode.description: given: the user named it. advised: worked out with domains/software/stack-guide.md.

stack.description: One entry per layer, e.g. backend, database, frontend.

packs.description: Answers to the grill me questions of each domain pack, keyed by pack name, e.g. the marketing brief. The software pack uses tech instead.

status.description: deferred: the user explicitly leaves it open; it is also listed in brainstorming.openQuestions.

source.description: existing: the agent file is already in the project. new: it will be created. example: it will be derived from one of the plugin's example roles.

phases.description: Phases in the format of phases from pipeline.schema.json, may still be incomplete.
